steps.label: Lymphangitis
lines: Lymphangitis is the inflammation of the lymph
In filariasis the worms and their dead bodies

steps.why: The two words differ only in their middle part, so the answer must state which structure each one names before anything else is written.
common_mistakes: Swapping the two. Angi- refers to the vessels.
Writing that lymphangitis is a swelling of the leg. That is elephantiasis, the end result.
steps.memory_tip: Angi- means vessel, as in angiogram: lymphangitis is the vessels.
steps.margin_note: One line naming the structure, one line on the cause. Do not write a paragraph.

steps.why: Aden- means gland in every medical word a student meets, so tying the answer to that root is what stops the pair being mixed up in the exam.
common_mistakes: Writing that lymphadenitis affects the vessels.
Leaving out the parasite. Both conditions are asked here as effects of Wuchereria.
steps.memory_tip: Aden- means gland, as in adenoid: lymphadenitis is the glands.
steps.margin_note: One line naming the structure, then one line naming the parasite that causes both.

insider_note: This pair is marked strictly on which structure each word names, so write VESSELS and GLANDS plainly before anything else.
